title: Device authorization codes
text: A connecting machine receives a four-character match code such as K7F2. Codes use 32 uppercase letters and digits without 0, O, 1 or I, accept lowercase input and expire after ten minutes. An active human organization member approves or denies the code, binding the decision to that person. Repeating the same decision is safe; another person or the opposite decision is refused. Polling delivers the credential once. In-flight longer codes remain usable until expiry.
